However the hurst_tag is mean-revert and breadth is still below 0.5, so this is high-quality leadership without momentum confirmation — lean direction only, no certainty.

theses.subject: Conglomerates & Exchange
theses.thesis: Conglomerates is the only other theme that is trend-gate eligible (eligible=true, durability_bar 0.50, mixed hurst). In a regime where eligibility is the one validated edge, Conglomerates is a legitimate second-leg trend-following lean within the same Financials family as the leader, and its crowded_z 0.29 and breadth 0.2 are modest rather than extreme. The lean is purely trend-discipline, not momentum — its score 0.738 is mid-pack.
theses.dissent: With only two eligible themes and the whole market glued to a one-narrative Banks story, Conglomerates may simply be a proxy for the same Banks move rather than an independent trend — if Banks fades, Conglomerates fades with it, giving no diversification.

theses.thesis: China Tech & Internet is scorable (ETF 3033.HK) but sits rank 13 with score -0.785, mean-revert hurst, crowding_z -0.90 and breadth 0.158 — everything about this state says the theme is out of leadership and failing the trend gate.
